name: The Moon in Autumn
source:
Ming Gui, a Peking University student, hesitates to join his family for Mid-Autumn. That night, a stranger leads him to the moon, where he bakes mooncakes and explores with the Moon Rabbit and Goddess, learning about tradition, bonds, and resilience.

[From [url=https://stockbridgehouse.itch.io/the-moon-in-autumn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
北京大学学生明贵犹豫着要不要和家人一起过中秋节。那天晚上，一个陌生人带领他来到月亮，在那里他烘烤月饼，并与月兔和女神一起探索，了解传统、纽带和韧性。

[来自[url=https://stockbridgehouse.itch.io/the-moon-in-autumn]Itch.io[/url]]
